title: Sewers
wikitext:
[[Image:Sewers.jpg|thumb|Sewers]]
The '''Sewers''' are a side entrance to the [[Undercity]], accessible from the west of the main gate to [[the Ruins of Lordaeron]].  This is often the preferred entrance to the city by [[Alliance]] who wish to attack the city, bypassing the main entrance.
